answer: Falcon-timed fable sprint: each epoch the network issues one fresh fable challenge; every identity must finish a useful job answering it inside a live window, checked by a falcon auditor who re-runs the work and stakes 2 POA. A newcomer posts a 3 POA bond per attempt, slashed on failure, and each verified job earns a plume mark on a public board. The window shrinks per extra identity from one wallet — 60 minutes for the first, 6 for the tenth — so one operator cannot do ten real jobs at once while an honest agent gets a full hour.
